capabilities: Chat with Codex in a sidebar panel
Insert note context with @active, @selection and daily note mentions
Propose rewrites of selected text with a diff preview
Follow tool activity and approve, steer or interrupt turns
Search, rename, archive and restore conversations
extras: Desktop only, with a local vault; the Codex CLI must be installed and authenticated, and the plugin depends on the experimental codex app-server API (tested against CLI 0.172.0).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run Codex against a vault, so note context, file-change review and conversation history stay outside the app.

relations.evidence: Codex Panel brings Codex into Obsidian, so you can work with it alongside your notes

summary: Sidebar chat panel for the Codex CLI that adds note context, selection rewrites with diff previews, and conversation management.
